Only replaced ZIP entry:
  addons/counterstrikesharp/plugins/NadeSystem/NadeSystem.dll

Customization:
  Per BOT, per round limits for NadeSystem-scheduled throws: flash=2,
  HE=1, smoke=1, molotov/incgrenade=1. The limit applies in normal,
  more, and max bot_nades modes at replay, instant-special, and
  retaliation entry points. Unknown grenade types retain upstream behavior.
  Non-emergency throws are paced across the round: one per BOT during
  the first 15 seconds after freeze end, no more than min(alive BOTs, 5)
  per team in that opening window, at least 5 seconds between throws by
  one BOT, and at least 0.5 seconds between throws by one team. Defuse
  cover and fire-extinguishing throws bypass pacing but not hard limits;
  plant cover bypasses only the opening team budget. Hard limits, pacing,
  money, team counts, and cooldowns commit only after entity creation.
  The limit adds no console output. Existing NadeSystem diagnostics and
  projectile error logs remain unchanged.

0.5.2 balance and audit customization:
  Planned candidates are collected then selected by deterministic score
  (molotov, HE, flash, smoke; Id ordinal tie-break), rather than JSON order.
  In the 15-second opening window, a team may commit at most one smoke and
  three non-smokes while retaining the min(alive BOTs, 5) total budget.
  HE and fire require live enemies within 450 units respectively;
  no-information probabilities are normal=1.00/1.00 and more=1.00/1.00
  (max=1.00/1.00). Normal PlannedReplay smoke is capped at one successful
  throw per team per round, with pending reservations cancelled on failure.
  Team-tagged, scheduled flashes may use a 1600-unit fallback at
  normal=0.45, more=0.70, max=1.00. Direct blindable flashes remain preferred.
  A single ASCII [NadeAudit] line is written only after a successful commit.
  tests/NadePacingPolicy.Tests.csproj parses logs and writes
  nade-audit-summary.txt/csv when given a log path.

Policy test:
  dotnet run --project tests/NadePacingPolicy.Tests.csproj -c Release

Audit log analysis:
  dotnet run --project tests/NadePacingPolicy.Tests.csproj -c Release -- <raw-console.log> <output-directory>
